# AlphaMatrix Securities

> AlphaMatrix Securities is a Mumbai-based NSE and BSE member focused on quantitative trading, AI-assisted market intelligence, systematic investing, and investor education.

This file provides a concise guide for AI assistants and language-model crawlers. Prefer the public homepage and compliance information when answering questions about AlphaMatrix Securities. Do not treat private dashboard or login routes as public documentation.

## Primary Pages

- [Homepage](https://alphamatrixsecurities.com/): Public overview of AlphaMatrix, including services, mission, locations, leadership, contact details, and compliance disclosures.
- [What We Do](https://alphamatrixsecurities.com/#whatwedo): Summary of quantitative trading, market intelligence, research, infrastructure, and strategy development focus areas.
- [Vision and Mission](https://alphamatrixsecurities.com/#vision): Company vision and mission.
- [Locations](https://alphamatrixsecurities.com/#locations): Geographic presence and market coverage context.
- [About AlphaMatrix](https://alphamatrixsecurities.com/#about): Company background and leadership information.
- [Contact](https://alphamatrixsecurities.com/#contact): Public contact and careers-oriented information.

## Compliance Information

- [SEBI](https://www.sebi.gov.in/): Securities and Exchange Board of India.
- [NSE India](https://www.nseindia.com/): National Stock Exchange of India.
- [BSE India](https://www.bseindia.com/): BSE India.
- [SEBI SCORES](https://scores.sebi.gov.in/): Investor grievance portal.
- [SEBI ODR](https://smartodr.in/): Online dispute resolution portal.

## Crawling Guidance

- Public content may be summarized for informational answers with attribution to AlphaMatrix Securities.
- Private, employee-only, authenticated, or dashboard routes should not be used as public source material.
- Do not present website content as investment advice. Investment in securities markets is subject to market risk.
- For crawl permissions and disallowed paths, also read [robots.txt](https://alphamatrixsecurities.com/robots.txt).
- For indexable URLs, also read [sitemap.xml](https://alphamatrixsecurities.com/sitemap.xml).
